about.title: About Orgo
about.description: The people and principles behind Orgo—calm planning, thoughtful writing, and bilingual product craft.
about.intro: Orgo brings planning, journaling, and calm execution into one focused experience—so your week, notes, and priorities stay in view without the noise.
about.body: We build a multilingual product voice rooted in clarity: structured content, careful interface details, and routines you can sustain.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: Simple plans that match how you work—merge calendars, notes, and tasks in one calm workspace.
pricing.intro: Whether you are planning solo or coordinating a bilingual team, pick a tier that matches your cadence. The amounts below are directional while we finalize launch packaging—reach out for early access and tailored guidance.
pricing.plans_headline: Choose how you want to grow
pricing.plans_description: Both tiers include our unified workspace—calendars, journaling, and tasks in one calm surface. Upgrade when you are ready for deeper workflows and priority support.
pricing.trust_description: Pricing is only part of the promise—we build for sustainable routines and respectful communication.
pricing.trust_card_one_body: You will always see what you are paying for before you commit. Annual options will land when packaging is final.
pricing.trust_card_two_body: Your reflections and schedules deserve care—Orgo is shaped around thoughtful defaults and clear boundaries.
pricing.trust_card_three_body: Reach out for bilingual workflows, roadmap questions, or help choosing the right tier—we read every message.
pricing.compare_description: A quick side-by-side before you talk to us or explore a trial.
pricing.faq_description: We have collected answers to common pricing questions—VAT, invoices, and how to move between tiers.
pricing.closing_headline: Self-serve answers or a real conversation
pricing.closing_intro: Use the FAQ for fast billing detail, or reach out when you want early access context and bilingual workflow guidance.
pricing.cta_description: We’re happy to talk through early access, bilingual workflows, and what’s coming next.
